MRI Information
The Umbra Fixation System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 40 T/m (4000 gauss/cm)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
Maximum active scan time 15 minutes
Wait time between sessions 10 minutes
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
